headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 11, 2026, the portfolio is showing a year-to-date return of 25.55%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.72%. This results in an average alpha of 11.84%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 47.40%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 15.91%, which still remains above the benchmark but highlights the variability within the portfolio. Such outperformance against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's holdings. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
